work: PRED-0018: Early-phase multi-country clinical trial site-network asymmetry benchmark across locked PRISMA-included Cystic Fibrosis interventional trials from PRED-0015 through PRED-0017.

claims.statement: Among 54 locked early-phase non-healthy-volunteer-only PRISMA-included systemic CFTR modulator and systemic PTC readthrough trials, 26 (0.481481: 1 omitted/empty locations, 27 single-country, 26 multi-country >= 2 sovereign countries; 26/53 = 0.490566 complete-case) register multi-country non-WITHDRAWN clinical trial site networks in ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 contactsLocationsModule.

methods.name: schema-validated sovereign canonicalizer and non-WITHDRAWN facility evaluator
methods.difference: parses PII-stripped locations through fail-closed ISO-3166-1 sovereign canonicalizer and counts systemic multi-country studies

methods.name: independent raw-JSON sovereign lookup auditor
methods.difference: separate file with zero re, math, or shared imports; canonicalizes raw JSON locations[].country and filters WITHDRAWN directly

claims.statement: Among 15 pure airway-restricted early-phase CFTR-restoring genetic, mRNA, viral-vector, liposomal, and oligonucleotide / splice-ASO trials, 5 (0.333333: NCT02532764, NCT02564354, NCT06429176, NCT06515002, NCT06962852; and 7/17 = 0.411765 across all-inhaled adding dual-route NCT05668741 and NCT06237335) register multi-country non-WITHDRAWN clinical trial site networks in ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 contactsLocationsModule.

methods.name: schema-validated pure-inhaled sovereign country evaluator
methods.difference: evaluates pure-route inhaled CFTR trials excluding dual-route co-administered systemic modulators

methods.name: independent raw-JSON pure-inhaled sovereign auditor
methods.difference: separate file with zero shared imports; counts pure-inhaled studies with >= 2 non-WITHDRAWN sovereign countries directly

claims.statement: Comparing 26/54 systemic vs 5/15 pure airway-restricted early-phase CFTR trials yields one-sided Fisher hypergeometric p = 10424417/44368472 (0.23495100 >= 0.01), and comparing 26/54 vs 7/17 all-inhaled trials yields p = 98997089/239686202 (0.41302790 >= 0.01).

methods.name: math.comb hypergeometric reduced Fraction numerator on pure-route (denominator 44368472; all-17 98997089/239686202)
methods.difference: computes reduced Fraction hypergeometric tail numerator via math.comb

methods.name: multiplicative Fraction product reduced numerator on pure-route (denominator 44368472; all-17 98997089/239686202)
methods.difference: computes reduced Fraction hypergeometric tail numerator via multiplicative Fraction products without importing math

claims.statement: On 26/54 systemic vs 5/15 pure airway-restricted early-phase CFTR trials (risk difference +0.148148), the sawtooth-safe unconditional Chan-Zhang 95% CI is [-0.149733, 0.396110] and the Newcombe-Wilson Method-10 95% CI is [-0.132089, 0.371460], both straddling zero.

methods.name: Cardano trigonometric restricted-MLE + golden-section multi-peak Chan-Zhang CI95 lower bound
methods.difference: solves Miettinen-Nurminen cubic score via Cardano acos/cos and golden-section multi-peak polish in float64

methods.name: pure-Decimal log-likelihood Newton-bisection + ternary multi-peak Chan-Zhang CI95 lower bound
methods.difference: solves unexpanded log-likelihood derivative in Decimal (28-digit scan refined at 50-digit precision) with zero float pre-screening and ternary multi-peak polish

claims.statement: Pre-registered PRED-0018 hypothesis is refuted on measured ClinicalTrials.gov data without post-hoc tuning: systemic early-phase CFTR trials registered multi-country site networks in 26/54 (0.481481) vs 5/15 (0.333333) pure airway-restricted inhaled CFTR trials (risk difference +0.148148; one-sided Fisher p = 10424417/44368472 = 0.23495100 >= 0.01; Chan-Zhang 95% CI [-0.149733, 0.396110] with lower bound <= 0; Newcombe-Wilson 95% CI [-0.132089, 0.371460] with lower bound <= 0, both straddling zero; all-17 inhaled 7/17 = 0.411765, p = 0.41302790 >= 0.01).

methods.name: float64 multi-country risk-difference evaluator
methods.difference: computes p_sys - p_inh_pure from schema-validated non-WITHDRAWN sovereign country sets

methods.name: independent raw-JSON multi-country risk-difference auditor
methods.difference: computes p_sys - p_inh_pure from independent raw JSON sovereign lookup evaluation
